description: A sixteen-step control voltage sequencer with a slider for each step

params.text: Takes 5V off the output, so the sliders run -5V to +5V rather than 0V to 10V; the lamp is lit while it is on
Sets the voltage the sequence puts out on its step, 0V to 10V

inputs.text: A rise here sets the sequence back to the first step
A rise here moves the sequence on by one step
With a cable here the voltage chooses the step directly and the step and reset inputs are not used, 0V to 10V across the sixteen sliders

outputs.text: The voltage of the step the sequence is on

notes: there is no clock in this module: the sequence moves one step each time a trigger arrives at the STEP input, unless a cable at POS is choosing the step instead

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
